title: Identify the constructor with the highest total points from races held on S
question: Identify the constructor with the highest total points from races held on Spanish circuits between 2005 and 2015. Return the constructor's name, nationality, total points, and the number of distinct races they participated in during this period.

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_024 AS constructor_name,
       c.XCL_025 AS nationality,
       SUM(cr.XCL_013) AS total_points,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cr.XCL_011) AS distinct_races
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022
JOIN races r ON cr.XCL_011 = r.XCL_065
JOIN circuits ct ON r.XCL_068 = ct.XCL_001
WHERE ct.XCL_005 = 'Spain'
  AND r.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
GROUP BY c.XCL_022
ORDER BY total_points DESC
LIMIT 1

structural_constraints.description: Participation in the second qualifying session (Q2) implies participation in the first qualifying session (Q1). The data confirms this: every row with a Q2 time has a Q1 time, but many rows with a Q1 time do not have a Q2 time.

Participation in the third qualifying session (Q3) implies participation in the second qualifying session (Q2). The data confirms this: every row with a Q3 time has a Q2 time, but many rows with a Q2 time do not have a Q3 time.

       c.XCL_025 AS nationality,
       SUM(cr.XCL_013) AS total_points,
       COUNT(DISTINCT cr.XCL_011) AS distinct_races
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN constructors c ON cr.XCL_012 = c.XCL_022

GROUP BY c.XCL_022
ORDER BY total_points DESC

SELECT c.XCL_023 AS constructor_name,
       c.XCL_025 AS nationality,
       SUM(r.XCL_083) AS total_points,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ra.XCL_065) AS distinct_races
FROM constructors c
INNER JOIN results r ON c.XCL_022 = r.XCL_076
INNER JOIN races ra ON r.XCL_074 = ra.XCL_065
INNER JOIN circuits ci ON ra.XCL_068 = ci.XCL_001
WHERE ci.XCL_005 = 'Spain'
  AND ra.XCL_066 BETWEEN 2005 AND 2015
GROUP BY c.XCL_022
ORDER BY total_points DESC
